topography.project_purpose: Revault is a yield optimization protocol on BSC that aggregates multiple vaults, staking pools, and auto-compounding strategies to maximize returns for deposited assets. Users can deposit tokens into various vaults and staking pools, which are managed through a system of fee receivers, zaps, and chef contracts.
topography.relationship_narrative: All product families share the RevaToken as the central incentive token, distributed by various RevaChef contracts to staking pools and vaults. Supporting contracts like Zaps and FeeReceivers are reused across multiple vaults and pools to handle deposits, swaps, and fee collection.
